definitions.explanation: The class of arthropods that includes crabs, shrimp, lobsters, and barnacles. Characterized by a hard exoskeleton. An important food category in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {甲殻類|こうかくるい}アレルギーがある。
{甲殻類|こうかくるい}は{日本料理|にほんりょうり}で{広|ひろ}く{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: Crustaceans are widely used in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {食品|しょくひん}の{成分表示|せいぶんひょうじ}には{甲殻類|こうかくるい}が{含|ふく}まれるかどうか{記載|きさい}されている。
examples.english: Food ingredient labels indicate whether crustaceans are included.

notes:
Composed of {甲殻|こうかく} (carapace, hard shell) + {類|るい} (class, type). Commonly encountered in food allergy contexts, as crustacean allergy ({甲殻類|こうかくるい}アレルギー) is one of Japan's designated allergens that must be labeled on food products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甲殻類|こうかくるい}アレルギー: crustacean allergy
- {甲殻類|こうかくるい}を{含|ふく}む: to contain crustaceans
- {甲殻類|こうかくるい}の{仲間|なかま}: members of the crustacean family

EXAMPLES OF CRUSTACEANS:
- {蟹|かに}: crab
- {海老|えび}: shrimp, prawn
- ロブスター: lobster
- {蝦蛄|しゃこ}: mantis shrimp

RELATED WORDS:
- {軟体動物|なんたいどうぶつ}: mollusks — another category of shellfish (squid, octopus, clams)
- {節足動物|せっそくどうぶつ}: arthropods — the broader group including insects and crustaceans
